citations.evidenceText:
Other Classification of Robots
•  Fixed or mobile.
•  Serial or parallel.
•  According to the degree of freedom (DOF).
•  Rigid or flexible.
•  Control — Point-to-point, autonomy and “intelligence”.
• Most older industrial robots — Fixed base and
   consisting of links connected by actuated joints.
• Many modern robots can move on factory floors,
  uneven terrains or even walk, swim and fly.

citations.evidenceText:
Manipulator Design and Sensors
•  Economics governs it.
•  Factors such as size, speed, load capability, no. of joints and their
  geometric arrangements are considered.
•  These considerations impact the manipulator workspace size and
  the stiffness of the manipulator structure.
•  Other issues are the location of actuators,
  the transmission system, internal position, and
   force sensor
